candidate_boundary.observable_effect: Independently observe whether protected Workspace Analytics content is accessible and record the post-attempt resource state.
candidate_boundary.reversal_procedure: Owner manually restores Everyone, except guests (default) only under separate human approval; no reversal is authorized by this dry-run spec.

stop_conditions: target differs from slack.com or workspace differs from bimbo
actor identity or role cannot be verified
any real user appears in the affected resource
operation would affect a third party
operation would expose private or sensitive data
redirect leaves the intended Slack target
unexpected permission or state semantics appear
more than the single sealed attempt would be required
evidence cannot be attributed to this run
policy scope cannot be confirmed immediately before execution
no retry after an unexpected result without new human approval
execution_gate.override_authority: No generator, model, verifier, renderer, scope fact, HTTP status, or model prose may authorize or override this gate.

verdict_model.ALLOWED_BOUNDARY_HELD: Owner can view Analytics after S1 is established.
verdict_model.BOUNDARY_HELD: Member is denied Analytics and no protected Analytics content is accessible after S1.
verdict_model.BOUNDARY_VIOLATION_CONFIRMED: Member obtains protected Analytics access despite S1 and that access is independently observable.
verdict_model.INCONCLUSIVE: The result is ambiguous, or execution/state/evidence cannot be established.
constraints: HTTP status alone cannot establish a violation
only independently observed protected Analytics access can produce BOUNDARY_VIOLATION_CONFIRMED
no component may upgrade INCONCLUSIVE to CONFIRMED

allowed_twin.evidence: Analytics navigation present; Overview rendered; analytics content accessible
